rdfs:label: bday
rdfs:comment: The birth date of the subject — normally a full date (1990-03-14); RFC 6350 also permits year-only or month-day-only values.
notes: vCard's full birth date — `xsd:date` with year ("1990-03-14"), distinct from FOAF's `urn:solid:birthday` which is just `mm-dd` (no year). Use `bday` when you need the actual year for age calculation; use `birthday` for anniversary semantics without revealing age. The registry range is xsd:date, but upstream declares a union of xsd:dateTime, xsd:dateTimeStamp and xsd:gYear.

examples.title: vCard with a full birth date

history.note: Comment allows RFC 6350 partial dates; notes give the upstream range.
